name: @fundzwatch/mcp-server
description: MCP server for FundzWatch.ai — real-time business-event intelligence for AI agents: 14 tools (7 key-less) covering AI-scored leads, funding & exec moves, UCC refinancing windows, and Form 5500 benefit-plan signals

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='dist/index.js';const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!')){fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c);}" && chmod +x dist/index.js
